_note: Seed for the Knowledge Engine. Every platform entry was fetched and its quote checked on retrieved_at. Levels: platform_rule (binding), platform_guidance (official recommendation), external_research (third-party, never a rule), hypothesis (to be tested), pln_evidence (written by the engine from PLN's own data — not seeded). Add entries via the dashboard; the weekly review re-checks every quote.

entries.statement: Judge Shorts by subscriber change, viewed-vs-swiped-away and by comparing high and low performers of the same content type — not each video against a viral outlier.
entries.quote: Observe what the differences are between the two
entries.source_title: Content tab analytics tips - Shorts - YouTube Help
entries.applicability: Creative Intelligence comparisons slice by platform and format; follows per 1k views and viewed-vs-swiped are YouTube north-star inputs once YouTube Analytics is connected.

entries.statement: YouTube says there is no minimum posting cadence for Shorts to perform; choose a sustainable schedule and focus on what the audience watches.
entries.quote: There is no minimum posting cadence required for your videos to perform well
entries.source_title: Search and discovery tips - Shorts - YouTube Help
entries.applicability: Starting YouTube cadences are hypotheses; the cadence engine may lower them when extra posts add no measured followers.

entries.statement: Facebook rewards original content (filmed/produced by the Page) and meaningful transformations; re-uploads, minor edits and low-value changes such as added borders or captions are treated as unoriginal and deprioritized, and repeated unoriginal posting can make an account non-recommendable.
entries.quote: considered unoriginal and will likely be deprioritized in Feed and Reels
entries.applicability: PLN amplification of a brand's clip must be a distinct treatment (different cut, angle and copy), never a re-upload of the brand's post. Enforced by routing + distinct-creative validation.

entries.statement: Instagram's Best Practices hub in the Professional Dashboard gives creators guidance on how often to post and how long Reels should be, plus engagement metrics — check it per account instead of applying generic numbers.
entries.source_title: Introducing Best Practices, an Education Hub for Creators on Instagram
entries.applicability: Record each account's in-app recommendation as a dated hypothesis when a human reads it; the cadence engine then tests it.

entries.statement: LinkedIn reports that companies posting weekly see about 2x engagement; it also reports higher engagement for video (5x) and live video (24x).
entries.quote: Companies that post weekly see a 2x lift in engagement with their content.
entries.applicability: Floor for the PLN company Page: at least weekly. The ratios are LinkedIn's own claims, not PLN measurements.

entries.statement: LinkedIn suggests notifying employees of the most important Page posts up to once per week to boost organic reach.
entries.quote: Notify employees of your most important Page posts up to one time per week
entries.applicability: A manual step a Page admin takes in LinkedIn; the agent only recommends which post.

entries.statement: Content posted through the Content Posting API by an unaudited client is private-only until TikTok audits the app.
entries.quote: All content posted by unaudited clients will be restricted to private viewing mode.
entries.applicability: TikTok adapter forces SELF_ONLY privacy until the audit is passed.

entries.statement: Instagram limits API-published posts per account in a rolling 24-hour window. The page states 100 in one place and 50 in the carousel section; the agent uses the lower figure.
entries.quote: Instagram accounts are limited to 100 API-published posts within a 24-hour moving period.
entries.applicability: Far above PLN cadences; daily caps come from the cadence engine, not this limit.

entries.statement: Media published through the Instagram API must be on a publicly accessible server when the publish call is made.
entries.quote: the media must be hosted on a publicly accessible server at the time of the attempt
entries.applicability: Approved renders are copied to media.proleaguenetwork.com before an Instagram publish.

entries.statement: Opening on the final/peak moment beats building suspense on follows per 1k views.
entries.applicability: Test: hook_style experiment, same series and slot, ≥5 posts per arm.

entries.statement: 15-second clips generate more follows per viewer than 30-second clips; the best length differs by property (CarJitsu vs Putt Tour pressure sequences).
entries.applicability: Creative Director produces A (≈12s) / B (≈25s) / C (≈40s) cuts; experiments compare them per property.

entries.statement: Clips featuring PLN commentators outperform natural competition audio.

entries.applicability: Returning viewers are only measurable on Facebook today (see measurability matrix).

entries.statement: Showing the CarJitsu brand in the first two seconds affects retention (direction unknown).

Starting posting cadences per brand and platform (config/cadence.json) are initial test schedules, not claims of algorithmic optimality; revise from each account's measured incremental follower growth.
